name: gameye-mcp
description: Launch, inspect and stop multiplayer game server sessions on Gameye from any MCP client.
long_description: MCP server for the Gameye game server orchestration API. Launch and stop dedicated server sessions, check image tags and regions, fetch logs and artifacts, and manage applications and scoped API tokens. Guardrails include dry-run mode, a default 30 minute session TTL, single-session stops, and masking of the API token in every result. Beta (0.x): tools may change between releases.

api_token.title: Gameye API token
api_token.description: Create one in the Gameye Admin Panel under Users, API tokens. Use the least-privileged scopes you need.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: sandbox for self-serve accounts (default), production for enterprise accounts.

tools.name: gameye_context
tools.description: Show the environment, host, server version and guardrail defaults

tools.name: gameye_describe_session

tools.name: gameye_stop_session
